sources.title: Tongue: Language identification on device | Desert Ant Labs
sources.snippet: Add Tongue from Desert Ant Labs to this project. On-device language identification that reads a short piece of text and names its language, across 84 languages, in tens of microseconds.

sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: Desert-Ant-Labs/tongue - GitHub
sources.snippet: Live demo: desert-ant-labs-tongue-demo.static.hf.space. Read the model card's failure modes before deploying. In short: one or two words is often genuinely ambiguous; Malay and Indonesian are not reliably separable at this size; Mongolian works only in the traditional script; and brand names and version strings are not language at all.

sources.title: Tongue Demo - a Hugging Face Space by desert-ant-labs
sources.snippet: On lingua's own test set, over the languages they share, the 2 MB model comes within a point of the 266 MB lingua and wins on full sentences. Word pairs are the hardest case for a small model. Very short or near-identical inputs, for example Malay and Indonesian, are hard for every detector; Tongue reports low confidence rather than guessing.
